info.title: PickChick foundation API
info.description: Local menu sync and unpaid POS orders, a gated synthetic TEST journey through two kitchen stations, and separate opt-in customer identity. Real identity requires approved policy URLs/version, protected keys, SMS budget and enabled Mobizon delivery. It never authenticates a local demo profile or adopts anonymous TEST history. Real checkout, payments and fiscal provider delivery remain disabled.

get.description: Returns the oldest unacknowledged event for the authenticated edge branch, or null. Repeated delivery is expected. No caller cursor is accepted.

404.description: Event outside device branch or missing

409.description: Sequence, release or checksum mismatch

post.description: Edge sends only after durable local commit. Cloud activates the release and stores the ACK in one transaction. Duplicate ACK is safe.

deviceBearer.description: Local provisioned 256-bit device key; revocable and expiring.

staffBearer.description: Local staff session secret, distinct from cloud device credentials.

testBearer.description: Opaque expiring TEST customer or station credential; staff issuance is trusted CLI only.

customerBearer.description: Opaque short-lived customer access token. Refresh rotation is persisted and revocable; no calendar or inactivity logout.

catalogManagerBearer.description: Opaque manager credential issued only through the trusted operator CLI; restricted to explicitly assigned branches.

staffTerminal.name: X-Terminal-Id
staffTerminal.description: Must match the active staff session terminal; does not replace the bearer secret.
